hero.title: Dinkum Tracker
hero.intro: A comprehensive tracking application for your Dinkum adventures. Manage multiple playthroughs, track collections, and monitor progress all in one place. Everything is saved in your browser, and you can sync it to your own cloud storage.

counts.title: Track Your Complete Collection
counts.intro: Manage every aspect of your Dinkum journey with a tracker built around the real item counts.

everything.title: Track Everything
everything.intro: All the tools you need for Dinkum success
everything.closing: From collecting bugs to managing relationships with NPCs, Dinkum Tracker helps you keep track of everything in your game.

pedia.title: Pedia Collections
pedia.text: Track all fish, bugs, and critters across seasons, locations, and times of day. Monitor your museum donations and collection progress.

npcs.title: NPC Relationships
npcs.text: Keep track of your friendships with town residents, gift preferences, and heart levels with all {count} NPCs.

calendar.title: Calendar Events
calendar.text: Keep track of important dates, birthdays, and seasonal events. Never miss another festival or special occasion in your Dinkum town.

needs.title: Everything you need
needs.intro: Keep track of all the details that matter in your Dinkum adventure.

milestones.title: Milestones and Licenses
milestones.two: Manage all licenses and their upgrade levels
milestones.three: View permit point progress and requirements

recipes.title: Recipes and Crafting
recipes.one: Track all cooking recipes and their ingredients
recipes.two: Keep track of crafting recipes and resources

collections.title: Collections and Resources
collections.one: Catalog all clothing and furniture items
collections.two: Track all resources and their uses

cta.title: Ready to start tracking?
cta.text: Begin organizing your Dinkum adventure today and never lose track of your progress again.
